notes: Identity verified from canonical text: Smile Intensity in Photographs Predicts Longevity; Ernest L. Abel and Michael L. Kruger; DOI 10.1177/0956797610363775; Psychological Science OnlineFirst, February 26, 2010. Primary Short Report with all three pages, methods, results, figure and references, not an abstract or secondary report. No PDF supplied. Results are on printed page 2 despite supplied p.1 locator. Only assigned original effect and p fields are completed; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. The Results explicitly describe the partial-smile versus nonsmile comparison as nonsignificant, but print no numeric contrast-specific effect/test statistic or p value/bound. Model and smile-addition chi-squares are omnibus tests; the printed HR/p pair is for Duchenne versus nonsmile. The antecedent of the opening right-column fragment is partial smilers in the preceding left-column sentence.
